title: PingAura AI: Agentic Marketing
description: Agentic marketing from VS Code chat. Your agent finds what AI engines miss on your site, fixes it in your code, and tracks the result with PingAura AI.

title: LogCrew
description: Analyze a local log file with a small agent crew (Parser → Clusterer → Explainer): clustered errors, timeline, and root-cause hypotheses with line-number evidence. Cost shown before any AI call. BYOK, no backend.

title: JB Commit Panel
description: JetBrains-style Git tool window: Local Changes with the diff in the panel, a Commit Changes dialog, and a Log with the commit graph, branches and filters.

title: auto-commit-system
description: Automatic Git history management with AI-generated commit summaries for beginner developers.

title: Java Module Manager
description: Eclipse-style Maven module open/close (close project): right-click or status bar to pick which modules to compile; the rest are not imported or compiled

title: Docket for Claude Code
description: Every open Claude Code session in one place: which are running, which need you, and one click to get there. Plus a board that sorts your sessions by feature, with a next step for each.

title: Docstep
description: Generates Python docstrings and updates them when the signature changes. A maintained fork of autoDocstring by Nils Werner.

title: Commit Graph Viewer
description: A simple, free, read-only view of your Git commit history as a graph.
